note: What a translation's card says about it, unasked: the line under its identity — a Main is told what waits on it or that it is its own, a branch what it has not sent and whose Main it hangs from, somebody holding another's lineage whose work it is, a file never published what to do with it — and the notice an author sees on their own published translation, most explaining first: a Main gone, a Main whose owner is gone, a road that closed, a Main taking nothing in (dismissable, it is a judgement), a publication with no translated line. A name never enters a sentence; it travels apart.
